named_result_bindings.label: lem:first-order
named_result_bindings.statement: For a local domain O and nonzero t in its maximal ideal, (1+tL) -> L mod maximal ideal is an additive group map on 1+tO.
named_result_bindings.conditions: Exact subgroup and domain divisibility, fixed SAME local ring/residue field for the final paired equations; not a numerical Taylor approximation.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: Use t=2 and t=1+i separately; odd-order residue-one torsion forces the products exactly one. Order 4 exception u=1 has Gaussian product i of even order.

named_result_bindings.label: thm:main
named_result_bindings.statement: Real circulant sign matrix, positive integer order n: existence iff n=1 or 4.
named_result_bindings.conditions: Cyclic shifts of ONE real sign row; exact HH^T=nI. Not general Hadamard matrices, complex phases or approximate conditioning.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: Witnesses (1) and (1,1,1,-1); no prime-factor restriction in final source claim.

named_result_bindings.label: cor:barker
named_result_bindings.statement: For n>1, a sign Barker sequence exists iff n is in {2,3,4,5,7,11,13}.
named_result_bindings.conditions: Every nonzero APERIODIC autocorrelation has absolute value <=1. Odd classification imported from Schmidt-Willms; selected additional Lean statement covers positive even lengths only.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: n=1 excluded by definition, although vacuously Barker if allowed. Even n>2 gives all nontrivial periodic correlations zero; n=2 handled separately.

named_result_bindings.label: lem:local-ring
named_result_bindings.statement: Cyclotomic unramified base is a DVR; adjoining a primitive p^k root gives a ramified DVR with coefficientwise p-divisibility.
named_result_bindings.conditions: p prime; p does not divide L; localize Z[eta_L] at a maximal ideal over p; k>=1. Free cyclotomic basis and integer valuation thresholds essential.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: D=(p-1)p^(k-1), v(p)=1, v(xi-1)=1/D. Eisenstein Phi_(p^k)(1+Y); no arbitrary local base substitution.

named_result_bindings.label: lem:comparison
named_result_bindings.statement: At primitive order-p character, factor/augmentation ratios are units congruent to 1 in the ramified residue field.
named_result_bindings.conditions: F,K in A[C_(p^e)], FK=p^e*b, b a unit, e>=1, unramified cyclotomic local base; same exponent in group order and scalar norm. Denominators nonzero.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: Projection qF/p after cyclotomic remainder division reduces e by one. Counterexample F=p-2J in C_p has norm p^2 and ratio -1 for odd p: exponent mismatch invalidates generalization.

named_result_bindings.label: lem:torsion
named_result_bindings.statement: Integral all-conjugates-unit-modulus element is torsion; residue-one torsion in residue characteristic p has p-power order.
named_result_bindings.conditions: Finitely many roots of unity generate B; ALL unital complex homomorphisms have modulus one. Second part requires a local domain and an actual root of unity.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: Finite integer characteristic polynomials of powers; non-torsion units congruent to 1 need not have finite order. One complex absolute value is insufficient.

named_result_bindings.label: prop:alternating
named_result_bindings.statement: For odd u>1 and x in Z[i][C_(u^2)] with xx*=u^2, the common alternating character product is an odd-order root of unity.
named_result_bindings.conditions: One fixed coefficient family x for every subset of all prime divisors of u; exact norm. Pair the SAME product in every prime direction and prove integrality at all maximal ideals.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: With at least two distinct primes product=1. For u=p^a, x=p^a X gives a possibly nontrivial order-p product; do not replace odd torsion by 1 universally.

named_result_bindings.label: prop:order
named_result_bindings.statement: A circulant Hadamard matrix of order n>1 has n=4u^2 with u positive odd.
named_result_bindings.conditions: Actual sign coefficients and scalar group-ring norm; augmentation gives n square; cyclic 2-primary projection and integral halving.
named_result_bindings.constants_and_limits: If n=2^(2s)u^2, s>=2, descent leaves 2^(s+1) odd coefficients with squared sum 4u^2, contradicting mod 8. This is an old Turyn-type restriction.

SchmidtWillms2016.locator: Section1 Theorem1, examples and correction footnote
SchmidtWillms2016.scope: Odd Barker lengths n>1: 3,5,7,11,13, with explicit examples. Later elementary proof of classical odd theorem; source footnote corrects a historical auxiliary induction range, not a refutation of odd classification.

LeungSchmidt2012.locator: Author PDF pp9-10 Thm3.5/proof; p11 Cor3.8
LeungSchmidt2012.scope: For u=p^a m, coprime(p,m)=1 and self-conjugate divisor r of m, require gcd of orders modulo p > u^2/(p^(2a)r^2) AND p^a>2m. Proof uses character-root quotients modulo2. These are conditional exclusions, not universal full classification.

Steinerberger2024.locator: Sections1.3,2 complete short proof; Section3.3 quantitative conjectures
Steinerberger2024.scope: Flat real Littlewood polynomials give circulant matrices with dimension-independent upper/lower singular bounds; DFT-root magnitudes are singular values. Exact orthogonality and approximate conditioning differ. Quantitative deviation n^(1/4) is conjectured there, not proved by F179.

notes: All7TeX1049lines and1bib191lines read; one manuscript,8named results. Whole source draft is not completed family/history audit.

C4 times C_(u^2) common sign blocks give c,d,g all exact norm u^2. Alternating ratios R=Delta(d)/Delta(c) and W=Delta(g)/Delta(c) have odd order and reduce to1 in ONE ring above2, hence exactly1. Separate t=2 and1+i first-order maps share residue field; Lr+Lw=J/c modulo maximal ideal. Nonempty character terms kill J, empty term u^2/c nonzero: contradiction.
u=1 has empty prime set; explicit c=d=1,g=i gives even-order W=i, preventing invalid universal odd-torsion extension.
Difference set equivalence (4u^2,2u^2-u,u^2-u) holds for all positive u before extra arithmetic oddness. General abelian Hadamard constructions do not contradict a cyclic theorem.
Positive even Barker n>2: periodic C(t)+C(n-t), mod4 congruence and shift2 imply4 divides n and all periodic nontrivial correlations vanish; n2 separate; odd classification old.

F076 source U approximate all-circle flatness,source S finite-Lp/merit,source L fixedlowerfloor are different quantifiers. n-root DFT flatness does not certify whole circle. Exact F179 does not supply a uniform positive deviation/stability bound.
